thread.title: Australian cricket champion returns: 'Extremely excited'

author: 7NewsSydney
title: Australian cricket champion returns: 'Extremely excited'
text: Australian cricket champion returns: ‘Extremely excited’ An icon of the game has been brought back into the fold after he knocked back a rival offer. It comes after Australia’sKnow the news with the 7NEWS app:As well as working closely with the team during next year’s Ashes tour, Hussey will be part of the side’s 50-over World Cup campaign next year and also act as an advisor for the 2028 LA Games — the sport’s first Olympic appearance since 1900 — and next T20 World Cup cycle. “I am extremely excited about being a part of the team in a more formal and meaningful role in the coming years,” Hussey said. “This team has achieved so much in recent times, to which I hope I can add value to the coaching and playing groups ahead of what will be an exciting and challenging period.”Credit: AAP Hussey averaged over 51 in Tests, 48 in 50-over cricket and 38 in T20 cricket, at a strike rate of 136.29, in more than 300 games for his country and has since had short-form coaching success in India and England. Cricket Australia’s national teams general manager Ben Oliver said it’s a massive coup to bring Hussey back into the fold.Add 7NEWS as your preferred news source on Google “Mike brings substantial international experience having represented Australia more than 300 times across his celebrated playing career.“He also has a deep knowledge of Australian domestic cricket and coaching experience that will be of great support to Andrew, his coaching team and the playing group. ” Head coach Andrew McDonald added: “Mike has been a highly valued part of our staff in the past and brings a considerable skill set which is complementary to the coaches and players.“Not only is his expertise as a player and coach across multiple formats, competitions, countries invaluable, so are his qualities as a person. ”
